evidence.title: Text to Speech App for Shadcn UI – Admin Dashboard Template

name: Text to Speech
summary: Text-to-speech app screen from the Shadcn UI Kit dashboard template: voices, models and voice tuning.
description: Live demo of the Text to Speech app included in the Shadcn UI Kit admin dashboard template: a text box with a 5,000-character counter, voice and model pickers, and voice adjustment controls (speed, stability, similarity, style exaggeration, speaker boost). Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui; part of a 16-dashboard kit sold for $79.
contains: voice adjustment: speed, stability, similarity, style exaggeration
included in Shadcn UI Kit: 16 dashboards for $79
